name: Coordinator board
description: Your coordinator agent in Orca: one click sets it up, then the board shows what needs you, work by ticket and running workers.

settings.title: Coordinator state folder
settings.description: Absolute path (~/ allowed) of the orca-coordinator state folder: board.json, coordinator-terminal, bin/cleanup, panel.json.

settings.title: Orca CLI
settings.description: Path of the orca CLI the worker runs. Empty = the app's bundled CLI on macOS, else `orca` on PATH.
